about: The Workbench icons of the PenguinCommand drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is upstream's own icon (data/gfx/icon.xpm, GPL 2 or later) as a PNG. PenguinCommand-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, PenguinCommand.info beside the program. ReadMe.info is also copied for upstream's README and the licences; Folder.info for data.
